title: ¿Are critical k-forests tight?
exact_target: Does being inclusion-maximal among these hypergraph forests force the corresponding connectivity property? The historical assertion has a six-vertex counterexample.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3293 (OPG-547). CC BY 4.0.
